meta.name: Paanch Phoron 720p
meta.description: Five directors come together to narrate five different romantic tales, with one common ingredient - "Love".

videos.title: Phoringer Bou
videos.overview: Young Chini is always bullied at school. But one day, something unforgettable happens in her life.

videos.title: Gopone Prem Charan
videos.overview: Somdatta has everything a woman can ask for - excepting the time of her husband. Will she eventually realise what the priorities in her life should be?

videos.title: Lilith
videos.overview: An agency located in future Bangladesh is trying to monitor truth ratings of individuals. Will it suddenly discover something unusual?

videos.title: Biroho Uttor
videos.overview: Jamil comes across his old flame from college and learns that she is now divorced. Is this just a coincidence or a twist of destiny?

videos.title: Ekti Paati Premer Galpo
videos.overview: Childhood friends Ayan and Tushki have recently developed feelings for each other. Will a sudden turn of events change their lives forever?

videos.title: Khworkuto
videos.overview: Ayan and Rajanya are about to walk away from each other, as their marriage slowly falls apart. Will Ayan be able to return the last piece of Rajanya's memory?

videos.title: Donor
videos.overview: Adnan is stuck between the love of his life and the man who gave him his life. Whose life will he save - and who will be sacrificed?

videos.title: Praay Kafka
videos.overview: Arindom wakes up to a brand new life, after a shocking change overnight. Will this new life push him away from the love of his life?

videos.title: Afternoon Audition
videos.overview: Three people struggle to get through a slow-paced afternoon in the city. What mystery lies beneath the shadow of past love?

videos.title: Three Kisses
videos.overview: Two brothers, Abhi and Ravi, are both in love with a girl named Dipa. But, who will finally win Dipa's heart?
